title: The Undertow of Room 214
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Gideon Brightwater, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
